plainTranslation: Their Pluto in your 1st house: they affect your sense of self powerfully, almost magnetically - you feel changed by them. Failure mode: that power tips into control over who you get to be. Let yourself be moved, hold your autonomy, and watch for domination.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
